description: This file contains shell script code for testing Git hook scripts and push operations, including setting up hooks, executing Git commands, and validating output and references.

methods.name: test_hook
methods.description: Sets up a test hook with specified commands, used to emulate hook execution during testing.

methods.name: test_tool
methods.description: A utility to run specific commands during the test, capturing output and exit status.

methods.name: make_user_friendly_and_stable_output
methods.description: Processes command output to make it more stable and user-friendly for comparisons.

methods.name: format_and_save_expect
methods.description: Saves expected output for comparison in tests.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares actual and expected output files.

methods.name: test_cmp_refs
methods.description: Compares Git references to expected references.
